# Karma and Samskaras

### Sri Mrinalini Mata • Self-Realization Fellowship

Welcome and blessings. Today, we reflect on the laws of karma and the deep impressions known as samskaras that are stored in our subconscious minds. Paramahansa Yogananda taught that while karma determines our outer circumstances, our inner attitude determines our destiny.

### Dissolving Karmic Bonds

Every action we perform leaves a seed of impression in our consciousness. When we meditate regularly, especially using the scientific technique of Kriya Yoga, we direct cosmic energy through our spine to burn these seeds before they can manifest as suffering. We are not helplessa victims of our past; we are master designers of our future.

### The Freedom of the Soul

No matter what mistakes you have made, you possess the capacity to rise above all karmic limitation. Seek the shelter of the Guru and know that under his protective guidance, the dense shadows of past errors dissolve into the infinite light of spirit.

### Practical Guidelines for Daily Life

* **Faithful Practice:** Rely on your daily meditation to purify your subconscious mind.
* **Defeat Bad Habits:** Replace old negative habits with positive spiritual actions.
* **Acknowledge Divinity:** Work without ego, offering all your service as a worship to God.
* **Rise Above Trials:** View every test as an opportunity to dissolve past karma gracefully.

Jai Maharaj! Jai Guru!
rawText: Karma and samskaras are stored in our subconscious but can be dissolved through the spiritual fire of Kriya Yoga meditation and selfless service...
